name: Awaken
description:
Casting time: 1 hour

Choose an animal or plant within Short Range.

The target gains the ability to speak one language that you know. Roll 1d4 and assign the result as its WITS score (you choose which Skills it gains ranks in).

If the target is a plant, it also gains the ability to move its limbs, roots, vines, creepers, and so forth. It gains senses similar to a humanoid's and the GM chooses any other statistics appropriate for the awakened plant.

The animal or plant is charmed by you for 1 day or until you or an ally cause it harm. After the day expires, the animal or plant remains awakened and chooses whether to remain friendly to you, based on how you treated it while it was charmed.
